episodeTitle.en: Why the AI’s honeymoon is ending (and tech workers are feeling it) | Noam Segal
episodeTitle.zh: AI 的蜜月期为何正在结束（科技从业者已经感受到了）｜Noam Segal

guestBioOfficial.zh: Noam Segal 与 Lenny 共同主持科技从业者年度调查。两人曾在 Airbnb 搭档做用户研究；此后 Noam 在 Intercom、Twitter、Meta、Figma 等公司带过研究团队。他关心的是，人们怎样描述自己的工作，以及调查问题怎样影响我们听到的答案。
guestBioOfficial.en: Noam co-leads the annual Tech Worker Sentiment Survey with Lenny, his former research partner at Airbnb. He has led research teams at Intercom, Twitter, Meta, and Figma. He is particularly interested in how the wording of a question changes what researchers learn about work.

title.en: Why the AI’s honeymoon is ending (and tech workers are feeling it) | Noam Segal
title.zh: AI 的蜜月期为何正在结束（科技从业者已经感受到了）｜Noam Segal

summary.zh: 同一个人可以觉得 AI 让自己做事更快，同时感到工作更累。Noam 和 Lenny 拆开调查中的这两种体验，又比较了不同岗位和公司规模的回答。读这期时值得留意分母：仍在经营公司的创始人，能代表哪些人？
summary.en: Noam and Lenny unpack a survey in which people can report getting better at their jobs while feeling worse at work. They compare roles and company sizes, then ask whose experience the survey misses.

insights.title: 采用率看不出使用者的感受
insights.detail: 样本中有 12% 的人被归入满腹怨气的一组。有人每天使用 AI，同时担心工作不保；单看使用频率，会把这种服从误读为热情。
insights.detailEn: Frequent use can reflect pressure. Some respondents in the 12% resentful group described using AI while fearing for their jobs.

insights.title: 问「做得更好」之后还要追问
insights.detail: 97.2% 的受访者认为 AI 让自己更胜任工作。Noam 随后拆问效率和质量，因为「更好」这个词容得下不同的判断。
insights.detailEn: After 97.2% said AI made them better at work, Noam probed what “better” meant for speed and for quality.

insights.title: 创始人满意度有一个看不见的分母
insights.detail: 调查中的创始人往往仍在经营公司。解读他们较高的满意度时，要把已经关停公司、可能没有进入样本的人考虑进去。
insights.detailEn: Founders who are still running companies can answer this survey. Those who closed theirs may be missing from the comparison.
insights.titleEn: Remember who can answer the survey

related.reason: 追问调查答案背后的经历：持续用户发现如何设计下一次访谈。
related.reasonEn: How continuous discovery interviews get behind a survey answer.

title.en: Build better products with continuous product discovery | Teresa Torres
title.zh: 通过持续产品探索打造更优质产品 | 特蕾莎·托雷斯
